commands.command: set -eu; DB="$HOME/tracker-field-captures/2026-09-13-post-walk-v68/tracker_database"; echo PUBLIC_SAFETY_REASONS; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT COALESCE(d.lastDeviceName,'(none)') AS name, d.deviceType, a.evidenceSource, a.confidence, a.reasonText, a.parsedValue, COUNT(*) AS events FROM alert_evidence_events a LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.fingerprint=a.deviceFingerprint WHERE a.eventType='PUBLIC_SAFETY_SIGNAL' GROUP BY a.deviceFingerprint,a.evidenceSource,a.confidence,a.reasonText,a.parsedValue ORDER BY events DESC,name;"; echo FOLLOW_ME_UNIQUE; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT deviceFingerprint) AS unique_devices FROM alert_evidence_events WHERE eventType='FOLLOW_ME_ALERT';"; echo FOLLOW_ME_DEVICES; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT COALESCE(d.lastDeviceName,'(none)') AS name, d.deviceType, d.trackingStatus AS current_status, ROUND(d.followingScore,1) AS current_score, COUNT(a.id) AS alert_events, MAX(a.timestamp) AS last_alert_ms FROM alert_evidence_events a JOIN devices d ON d.fingerprint=a.deviceFingerprint WHERE a.eventType='FOLLOW_ME_ALERT' GROUP BY a.deviceFingerprint ORDER BY alert_events DESC,last_alert_ms DESC LIMIT 30;"; echo APPLE_FRAGMENTATION; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "WITH a AS (SELECT d.fingerprint,d.firstSeenAt,d.lastSeenAt,COUNT(s.id) AS samples FROM devices d LEFT JOIN signal_samples s ON s.deviceFingerprint=d.fingerprint WHERE d.manufacturerId=76 AND (d.deviceType IN ('TRACKER','AIRTAG','TAG') OR d.beaconType LIKE '%Find%' OR d.sensorData LIKE '%Find%') GROUP BY d.fingerprint) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(CASE WHEN samples=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN samples=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_sample, SUM(CASE WHEN samples<=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS at_most_2_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN lastSeenAt-firstSeenAt<=10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lifetime_le_10s, ROUND(AVG(samples),2) AS avg_samples, MAX(samples) AS max_samples FROM a;"; echo APPLE_SAMPLE_BUCKETS; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "WITH a AS (SELECT d.fingerprint,COUNT(s.id) AS samples FROM devices d LEFT JOIN signal_samples s ON s.deviceFingerprint=d.fingerprint WHERE d.manufacturerId=76 AND (d.deviceType IN ('TRACKER','AIRTAG','TAG') OR d.beaconType LIKE '%Find%' OR d.sensorData LIKE '%Find%') GROUP BY d.fingerprint) SELECT CASE WHEN samples=0 THEN '0' WHEN samples=1 THEN '1' WHEN samples<=2 THEN '2' WHEN samples<=5 THEN '3-5' WHEN samples<=10 THEN '6-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS devices FROM a GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN '0' THEN 0 WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3-5' THEN 3 WHEN '6-10' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END;"; echo APPLE_IDENTITY_CANDIDATES; sqlite3 -header -column "$DB" "SELECT COUNT(*) AS candidates FROM identity_continuity_candidates c WHERE c.deviceFingerprint IN (SELECT fingerprint FROM devices WHERE manufacturerId=76 AND (deviceType IN ('TRACKER','AIRTAG','TAG') OR beaconType LIKE '%Find%' OR sensorData LIKE '%Find%')) OR c.candidateFingerprint IN (SELECT fingerprint FROM devices WHERE manufacturerId=76 AND (deviceType IN ('TRACKER','AIRTAG','TAG') OR beaconType LIKE '%Find%' OR sensorData LIKE '%Find%'));"
